CloseResource: Open it in a try-with-resources block so it closes on every path.
EmptyCatchBlock: Log the exception with LOG.error, or rethrow it.
MissingStaticMethodInNonInstantiatableCl: Add a static factory method that returns an instance, or widen the constructor.
UseLocaleWithCaseConversions: Pass an explicit locale, toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), so the result does not follow the server's default.
UnusedFormalParameter: Remove the parameter and the arguments passed to it at the call sites.
UseStandardCharsets: Use StandardCharsets.UTF_8 instead of the charset name.
PreserveStackTrace: Pass the caught exception as the cause: throw new XException(message, e).
DoubleBraceInitialization: Build it with Map.of(...)/List.of(...) or plain put/add calls, without the anonymous subclass.
UnusedPrivateField: Delete the field; nothing reads it.
NonExhaustiveSwitch: Add the missing enum cases, or a default branch.
UnusedLocalVariable: Delete the variable; nothing reads it.
